chapter: New York, Nick's and the Army
title: Nick Rongetti hires him as leader on the spot
summary: At Nick's he sits in with Brunis, Pee Wee Russell and Marty Marsala, and Nick makes him leader the next night, arranging a union card.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And, of course, Nick's was always changing. And, I got to hear all these guys, and it happens that I was down at Nick's one night and I went in to see Brad Gowans' and he wasn't there and I didn't know exactly who was on the bandstand so I got in there and I noticed that it was George Brunis and PeeWee and the trumpet player's name was Marty Marsala - yeah - and, the rhythm section I think was Danny Alvin and, uh---
No. And, so, I sat at the bar was listening and Nick was there ---

And, he said - say - are you Wild Bill Davison--- and I said, yes - that's me. He said, I want to hear you play. He said, would you play the next set? And, I said - oh, maybe the band won't like that--- he said, well, I'm losing that trumpet player tomorrow night. I'd like to hear you play -- would you do it -- I said, yeah - I had to go out and get my horn out of the car and I went up and played and when I got off the bandstand and playing with those guys - it was kind of frightening in a way too -- because I had never played with these guys before and so, when I got off the stage he said --- okay - you start tomorrow night. I said - start tomorrow night

He said - 'you'll be the leader - starting tomorrow night' -- I said - 'wait a minute -- Nick -- I don't belong to the union here.' He said - 'well, don't worry about that, you will tomorrow night.' Now, I don't know -- he must have had a great influence with the Federation in the fact that he had used so many musicians. So, they gave him a card for me and that's how I got in the union in New York. And, on the next night, I was the leader at Nick's.
Now, do you remember who was in that band?
All the same guys except Marty---
Okay but, well, we'll worry about that...
Well, I don't just remember who was on bass, but---
Well, we named most of them---
